description: This file contains source code for backporting certain TensorFlow graph transformation operations, specifically converting newer operation versions (like ConcatV2 and TensorArrayV3) to their older versions for compatibility purposes.

methods.name: absl::Status BackportConcatV2Transform(const GraphDef & input_graph_def,const TransformFuncContext & context,GraphDef * output_graph_def)
methods.description: Transforms 'ConcatV2' nodes to 'Concat' nodes by swapping input order and modifying attributes.

methods.name: absl::Status BackportTensorArrayV3Transform(const GraphDef & input_graph_def,const TransformFuncContext & context,GraphDef * output_graph_def)
methods.description: Transforms 'TensorArrayV3' nodes to 'TensorArrayV2' versions, removing the second output by substitution.
